summary: Scheduled publisher froze for 12.26 h on 2026-10-20 (two consecutive failing scheduled runs), exceeding the brief's ≤8 h refresh bound. Root cause reproduced with frozen-clock replay: a wall-clock-dependent test assumption in tests/test_build.py::GlanceIndexTests collided with the freshness-determinism guard's absolute pinned instant 2026-10-20T12:00:00+00:00 and failed the pre-collection regression step for every run started on 2026-10-20 between about 04:01Z and 09:01Z. Fixed by giving the failing test an explicit synthetic time basis (the repository's own injected-time contract). No probability, pick, alias, source or renderer value was changed anywhere.

frozen_publisher_window.visible_staleness: The public site kept serving the 2026-10-20T01:29:53Z inventory; the site's own 8-hour staleness rule visibly demoted it from about 09:29:53Z until the recovery deploy at ~13:42Z (about 4 h 13 min of labelled stale data). No unreconciled or invented data was published.

misleading_annotations_analysis.finding: The four SourceError lines are NOT diagnostics of the failure. They are printed by scripts/collect.py's degraded path while executing four PATCHED synthetic tests in tests/test_domain.py::SourceSafetyTests (test_failed_replay_never_changes_the_published_snapshot, test_partial_inventory_failure_cannot_overwrite_last_good_evidence, test_source_failure_does_not_claim_empty_inventory, test_source_failure_preserves_success_timestamps).
misleading_annotations_analysis.proof: Successful run 39524645584 (2026-10-21T00:59:38Z) carries the identical four SourceError annotations (check-run enumeration via the official API returned count=4). The same four lines appear in a green local run of tests.test_domain. They are suite noise present in every run, success or failure.
misleading_annotations_analysis.consequence: The only signal in the failed runs was 'Process completed with exit code 1'. The real failing test name was unreachable from this sandbox.
misleading_annotations_analysis.remediation: .github/workflows/pages.yml now publishes unittest FAIL/ERROR lines as ::error annotations exactly like .github/workflows/checks.yml already does, so the next occurrence is self-describing in the official annotations feed.

log_access_limitation.note: The sandbox egress allowlist covers github.com/api.github.com only; run logs and artifact bytes redirect to hosts outside it. The frozen-clock replay below is how root cause was established without log access.

root_cause.guard: tests.test_freshness_determinism.PinnedClockTests.test_the_suite_passes_with_the_clock_pinned_to_several_absolute_times re-runs the time-sensitive module suite with scripts.* modules' datetime pinned to absolute instants including '2026-10-20T12:00:00+00:00'.
mechanism: GlanceIndexTests.match() built fixture start/lock/observation times from wall-clock datetime.now() (call it T0) and the test called glance() without now=, so inside the guard's pinned re-run glance() classified rows at pinned time P = 2026-10-20T12:00Z against fixtures defined relative to the real T0.

glance() shows at most 10 resolved upcoming rows (open_rows), ALL unresolved rows (blank + past_blank), and at most 6 resolved past/locked rows (resolved_rest). The hidden>0 footer reads 'Showing X of N; every unresolved fixture is included.'; the hidden==0 footer reads 'All N active fixtures are listed.' instead.

The test hard-asserts the hidden-path sentence. With 12 resolved matches starting T0+2h..T0+13h and 2 unresolved rows, hidden = 14 - (min(open,10) + 2 + min(rest,6)) is 0 exactly when 6 <= open <= 10, i.e. when T0 falls in 2026-10-20 ~04:01Z..~09:01Z. Both failed runs (04:50:59Z, 07:56:14Z) are inside the window; the neighbouring successes (01:17:47Z, 13:33:30Z) and all runs after 2026-10-20 (fixtures a full day past the fixed pin, open=12 capped to 10) are outside it.
Result: identical head SHA passes or fails depending only on the wall clock — the same wall-clock-bomb class as the 2026-10-17 publisher freeze, in a different test.
root_cause.why_only_that_day: The pin is a fixed literal (2026-10-20T12:00Z). For every run whose real date is after 2026-10-20, all 12 synthetic resolved starts fall after the pin, so open=12 and the cap always triggers (hidden=2). The collision window existed only on 2026-10-20 ~04:01Z-~09:01Z.
root_cause.production_runtime_is_correct: glance() itself behaves correctly for real now=build-time data: it never drops unresolved rows in either branch; only the TEST's assertion assumed the capped branch would always be taken. No runtime change was made.

pre_fix.result: 740 tests, 1 failure: the guard reports GlanceIndexTests.test_unresolved_fixtures_are_never_dropped_and_never_given_a_50_50 failing at pinned 2026-10-20T12:00:00+00:00 with ''every unresolved fixture is included' not found'.
pre_fix.note: The stored JSON's single failure entry is trimmed (the original message embedded ~14 KB of rendered HTML with no extra diagnostic content); the assertion text is intact and the reproduce command is recorded in the file.

fix.change: GlanceIndexTests.match() gains an optional `base` instant (default: previous wall-clock behaviour, used by tests whose assertions hold in both glance branches); the failing test now builds all fixture times from a fixed synthetic base 2026-10-20T12:00Z and calls glance(..., now=base). Every original assertion is unchanged: both unresolved rows present, zero '50.0%' occurrences, '2 explicitly unresolved', hidden-path footer sentence.
